Geographies Served Programs Bridge Learning Programmes (Educational Programmme) District Bangalore State Karnataka District Bangalore States Karnataka Gubbachi Connect: It is for the age group 6-9 years old. The objective is to Integrate out-of-school youngsters into the regular school system is the goal. A dynamic and adaptable Fast Track curriculum with an emphasis on reading, writing, and numeracy that is appropriate for the child's nomadic lifestyle. Gubbachi Proactive: It is for the age group 10-17 years old. The objective is to close the learning gaps that exist in preadolescent and adolescent kids. The approach is more focused, working with smaller groups to get them ready for NIOS, mainstream education, or career training. Gubbachi Transform: It is for the age group 6-9 years old. The goal is to enable government primary school students to receive a top-notch education. The Nali-Kali curriculum is multi-grade, and multi-level, and is implemented in partnership with the Department of Education. To do this, the Gubbachi Enable initiative prioritizes community involvement and welfare with a particular emphasis on facilitating healthcare, education, and documentation.
